SOURCE EXCERPT:
Indirect costs are recovered on sponsored awards at the university's federally negotiated rate, currently fifty-four percent of modified total direct costs for on-campus research and twenty-six percent for off-campus. An activity is off-campus when more than half of the work is performed in space not owned or leased by the university; a single award may not apply both rates. Modified total direct costs exclude equipment over five thousand dollars, tuition remission, and the portion of any subaward above the first twenty-five thousand dollars. Where a sponsor publishes a rate limit below the negotiated rate, the published limit applies and the difference is recorded as cost sharing only if the sponsor requires it. Waivers of the negotiated rate are granted by the Vice Provost for Research and require a written case showing strategic benefit to the university; the need to be competitive on price is not by itself a sufficient case. Waivers are recorded centrally and reported to the Faculty Senate annually in aggregate.
